{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Broccoli Salad|Broccoli Salad]]

This '''broccoli salad''' is often served at potlucks.
== Ingredients ==
* 7–8 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (700–800 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 1.5–1.8 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]]) [[Cookbook:Broccoli|broccoli florets]]
* 7–8 slices of crisp fried [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], crumbled (smoked bacon works well)
* 1 red or sweet [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] (Vidalia are recommended)
* 1 [[Cookbook:Apple|apple]], chopped (optional)
* 1 cup (80 g / 2.8 oz) [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]], plumped in boiling water
* 1 cup (250 g / 8.8 oz) [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]]
* ½ cup (110 g / 3.9 oz) granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]] (or equivalent artificial sweetener)
* ½ cup (40 g / 1.4 oz) [[Cookbook:Pecan|pecans]] or [[Cookbook:Sunflower|sunflower seeds]]
* dash of [[Cookbook:Cider vinegar|cider vinegar]] or [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon juice]]

== Procedure ==
#Whisk mayonnaise, sugar, and vinegar together.s
#Mix remaining ingredients and combine completely in a large bowl.
#Cover.
#Cool in the refrigerator overnight before serving.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*Keep refrigerated.
*May be served with additional pecans or sunflower seeds sprinkled over the top.
*2 bunches of broccoli should supply enough florets. If not, then add stems and stalk (peeled and chopped finely).
